Stephen, you will be missed! I’ve loved being on your show. Thank you… Good Night and Good Luck from London.


Variety (@Variety)

David Letterman was one of Stephen Colbert's final guests on #TheLateShow, as the franchise's two hosts go their revenge on CBS by throwing furniture off the roof of the Ed Sullivan theater.

Happy 1 year of The Ex Files!

From politics & world affairs to personal reflections (and zero fisticuffs!), the exes @amanpour & @JamesP_Rubin have covered just about everything!

Thank you for listening, sharing, and being part of every conversation. Here's to the next chapter!

Video

Huge congratulations to the winners, especially the brave Elaheh and Elnaz Mohammadi, for their truly fearless reporting.


International Women's Media Foundation (@IWMF)

We’re incredibly proud to announce the winners of our 2026 Courage in Journalism Awards: Elaheh and Elnaz Mohammadi of Iran, @ByGeorgiaFort of the United States, and Nay Min Ni of Myanmar.





— https://nitter.net/IWMF/status/2054942872911147476#m

As Trump embarks on a summit with Xi Jinping seeking help to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. @amanpour  reflects on their last meeting & why Trump is negotiating from a weaker position

Watch Christiane Amanpour Presents: The Ex Files 🗂️ on @globalplayer 🎧

Video

“This mix of indifference and denial is the consequence of decades of occupation, which led to dehumanization of Palestinians.” Israeli historian and scholar of genocide @bartov_omer tells me about the conclusions he reached in his new book, “Israel: What Went Wrong?”.

Video

When she met President Trump, Venezuelan opposition leader @MariaCorinaYA gifted him her Nobel medal. Was it worth it? “Yes,” she tells me. “President Trump is the only head of state that has risked the lives of some of his citizens for freedom and democracy in my country.”

Video

“There have been very important steps taken” by the US in Venezuela, says @MariaCorinaYA. But when will elections be held? “We trust what we’ve heard from the US government,” she tells me, suggesting a possible timetable sooner than the end of Trump’s second term.

Video

Venezuelan Nobel Peace Prize laureate @MariaCorinaYA has been out of her country since she made it to Oslo last December. She has vowed to return, and tells me it will be “as soon as possible,” when security allows.

Video

A final word on Ted Turner from one of the loves of his life. What his former wife, and Oscar-winning actress, Jane Fonda once told me about his hidden legacy, and what she thinks awaits him in the afterlife:

Video

From the archives, a celebration of the life of Sir David Attenborough, as the great nature documentarian celebrates 100 years on planet Earth! Here's some of our conversation about his most memorable moments:

Video

On #TheAmanpourHour this week, a special program on the late, great Ted Turner:
• What the CNN founder told me about success, failure and facing up to his father;
• Plus, @WalterIsaacson  reflects on Turner’s legacy and discusses his book "The Greatest Sentence Ever Written".

Video

“People are over tech bros telling us our jobs aren’t important”

Following her cameo in the Devil Wears Prada sequel, @TinaBrownLM joins @amanpour to discuss how the film reflects the real pressures facing the media industry.

#devilwearsprada

Video

We are proud to showcase @JDiamond1 and @AbeerSalmanCNN's reporting on our beleaguered yet fearless Palestinian press colleagues, following the mandate set by our late leader Ted Turner: to tell the truth and always cover all sides of the story.

Palestinian journalist Ali al-Samoudi was recently released from Israeli prison, where he was held for a year without charge and without a trial. He lost around half his body weight behind bars. “It was a real hell,” he tells @JDiamond1, in this heart-wrenching report.

Video

“Attenborough is an intelligent young man, but he should not be used as an interviewer because his teeth are too big.” The legendary David Attenborough recounts the rather harsh feedback he got from the boss when he first stepped in front of the camera…

Video

Observing animals “takes you out of the human condition,” David Attenborough told me in 2016, recalling a time when he glimpsed a lagoon with nature undisturbed, “a moment of revelation, of a recognition that there’s something beyond us.” He turns 100 years old today.

Video

“We have to get back to that notion of common ground.” @WalterIsaacson reflects on America’s 250th anniversary and what he calls “The Greatest Sentence Ever Written”.

Video
